description: Comment "Routine" and I'll send you the full guide 👇 Claude just dropped something that's going to save you 20 hours a week and almost nobody knows about it. It's called Routines and it lets Claude schedule tasks completely on its own. You don't even need your computer open. Here's how to set it up: Open Claude desktop app → Code → Routines Set the routine to Cloud so it runs even when your computer is closed Name your routine and write instructions (or ask Claude to write them for you) Schedule when you want it to run Connect it to any connectors you already have set up Then go to Claude settings → Notifications and turn on alerts so it emails you or sends a phone notification the second each routine finishes. I have one that cleans out my inbox every morning at 9AM, and another that emails me every Sunday with exactly what I need to get done that week. #ai #claude #claudecode #productivity #aitools
